_comment: Optional endpoint allow-list for bridge/vb6mcp_hub.mjs. COPY to bridge/hub_remotes.json (that is the file the hub reads) or pass the same JSON array through the VB6MCP_REMOTES environment variable. An endpoint is only ever PROBED when it is listed here - the hub never discovers hosts. Empty/absent => every remote code path is inert and the hub behaves exactly as before.
_shape: array of {label, url, note}. label: 2..32 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_.-]; 'local' is reserved and cannot be configured. url: http(s)://host:port (an explicit path such as http://host:8796/rpc wins over the add-in default /rpc).
_target_syntax: [endpoint:]selector. endpoint omitted = local. selector = normalized project path (canonical) | pid | port | project NAME (the last three are legacy aliases).
_example: replace <remote-host> with the host that runs the IDE you want to reach; keep the port your relay listens on.

remotes.label: example-remote
remotes.note: the remote machine's IDE behind a loopback relay
